title: SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting

claim.summary: SEER conditions a frozen LLM forecaster on retrieved events and turns forecast residuals into two decoupled textual updates, a retrieval/selection memory and a persistent causal knowledge base, both indexed up to the forecast cut-off.

modules.name: Error-driven reflective retrieval memory
modules.scope_reason: Retrieval and selection memories are revised by diagnosing forecast residuals against realized outcomes, so the memory state is tied to the forecasting output contract.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "Memory-Guided Expansion and Filtering: The"
PDF p.6; passage beginning "Notably, all retrieved exogenous events"

modules.name: Forecast-error causal knowledge distillation
modules.scope_reason: Persistent causal rules are derived from past forecast errors and condensed to condition later forecasts; the update signal is forecast loss on realized outcomes.
